notes.title: The Maze Project Update 0.3.2
notes.notes:
This update includes quality of life changes that should make the game progression better.

[h2]Tasks[/h2]
There are now tasks on the right side of the screen. Tasks are added automatically based on the game progression that the player has done. These tasks are meant to guide and help the player with the game progression. They can be toggled on or off, based on the player's preference.

[h2]New Maze Creation Options[/h2]
The save creation screen has been revamped. It now includes two sections: Basic and Advanced. The basic section contains basic things such as name, seed, and whether cheats are on or off. The advanced section now includes two new options.

The first one is the maze generation algorithm. This allows the player to pick a way by which the maze is generated. There are 5 maze generation algorithms: recursive tree, pure recursive, random tree, oldest tree, and recursive division. The recursive tree algorithm is by default.

The second option is the ability to configure maze width and length. By default, the maze size is 20x20, but it can be anywhere between 10x10 and 100x100. Please keep in mind that larger maze sizes might reduce performance as of the time being!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tasks to better guide the player.
[*] Added a new keybind to show/hide tasks.
[*] The save creation screen now has 2 tabs: Basic and Advanced.
[*] Added an option to modify the maze generation algorithm.
[*] Added an option to modify the maze X and Y size.
[*] The save creation screen now validates the input and disables the "Create" button if it's incorrect.
[*] Every maze feature now has a minimum radius of 0.
[*] The active player effects are now laid out horizontally in the HUD.
[*] The door numbers in the first maze are now next to the door instead of being on the door.
[*] Fixed a bug where some players couldn't see the poppet manifestation properly in multiplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: The Maze Project Update 0.3
notes.notes:
The Maze Project Update 0.3 is here. It took a little bit longer than initially expected, mainly for rewriting many systems to be compatible with loading and unloading multiple mazes.

This update rewrites many of the game's core systems.

[h2]A Brand New Maze[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44896019/4882efd627414ccbe64f025c326a1b10e8b8d9dd.jpg[/img]
A brand new maze awaits for you! New puzzles, new manifestation and new items. Enter its captivating, foggy atmosphere and survive alone or with friends. The new manifestation featured in this maze has a better AI, allowing it to have different behaviors. There are also day and night cycles in the second maze. During the night, the visibility gets lower and the manifestation awakens, but beware, once it awakens, it doesn't rest until it gets you, even when it's day! Some parts of the first maze has also gone through a little bit of a redesign.

[h2]Upgraded AI[/h2]
Some of the AI logic has been upgraded to utilize the GOAP approach. GOAP is a sophisticated AI strategy that allows systems to dynamically plan actions to achieve specific goals, resulting in more intelligent and efficient behavior.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44896019/954f0d1be1ab6d199b383ee8beee0bbab20eeceb.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Networking[/h2]
The networking had a major improvement regarding synchronization. This should eliminate various bugs that were caused by objects not being properly synchronized. The lobby system has also been rewritten because of the new networking system, which makes it more efficient and allows for new things such as UI animations.

[h2]Dual Item Handling[/h2]
When holding an item, it now shows in your hand and makes you actually hold it. I know, it's awesome!  Now you can also use the item that you are currently holding by right clicking. The usage depends on the item, for example a Vial of Mystery would get consumed, whereas a Metal Trap would get dropped on the ground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44896019/810704ed02f1a51df6a2d4a3bbbdce7f2b1700e0.png[/img]

[h2]Cheat Console[/h2]
A new cheat console can be activated by pressing the ` key. From this console, you can execute various commands that modify the game. You can get started by typing the "help" command for a list of commands. This serves as a more advanced way of modifying the game. You can still use the Cheat Menu for less advanced things, such as giving yourself items or teleporting to various maze structures.

[h2]Bug Fixed[/h2]
Various bugs have been squashed and fixed, including networking issues, resulting in a better gameplay experience.

notes.title: The Maze Project Demo is Now Officially Available
notes.notes:
[h2]A demo version, finally![/h2]

I'm happy to announce a brand new demo version of The Maze Project. This demo version is now available for free to everyone. Invite your friends or family to share some scary experiences and test your logical thinking in some of the challenges that the maze lays down on you.

This project has come a long way from its early beginnings from before two years to now, and now I want to share that progress with you so you can try out the game and get a feeling for yourself of how the game is in its current state.

[h2]What about other platforms?[/h2]

The first, and the only one for now, is Windows. There will be support for the macOS and Linux operating systems sometime later. The game needs to be further tested when it comes to these systems, so it can be fully optimized and run smoothly.

[h2]How long will the demo last?[/h2]

There are no plans as of now to end the demo. Even though the main reason for the demo was the upcoming Steam Next Fest, the demo will stay up even after the Next Fest ends.

[h2]Is the first maze different in some shape or form from the full version?[/h2]

As of now, the first maze has almost identical features as the one in the full version of the game. There were some tweaks when it comes to the story elements that are laid out throughout the maze, so it won't spoil some of the planned story. Functionality wise, same puzzles, same manifestations and same game progression.

[i][b]Fun fact:[/b] This version of the game is actually more up to date, because it is built of off the v0.3 version, which is not even accessible to the game testers yet.[/i]

[h2]Limitations of the demo version[/h2]

There are some limitations when it comes to this version of the game.

[list]
[*] No multiplayer access
[*] Only one save allowed at a time
[*] Less content than in the full game
[*] Only the first maze is included
[*] Steam achievements are disabled
[/list]
[h2]Bugs[/h2]

Since the game is in early access, the demo may be prone to some bugs. Feel free to use the in-game bug reporting feature that can be found in the game settings to report any bugs you encounter along your way. The demo version will receive bug fixes and maybe occasionally some game content updates to make the demo more fun.

notes.title: The Maze Project Update 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Hey there! The 0.2.1 update is out! This update includes a few major bug fixes as well as something new.

[h2]New Item[/h2]
[b]Anxiety pills[/b] is a new item that can be found in the maze. It has the ability to remove all of your negative effects, but be aware that it has a 15% chance to [i][b]not[/b][/i] remove a negative effect.

[h2]Poppet Manifestation Addition[/h2]
There is a new addition to the poppet manifestation - the small guys that spawn in the cardboard boxes in the small room. They now can escape from their room and be able to roam around the maze. But they are very shy, they'll hide as soon as you see them.

[h2]Expansion Pouch Visual[/h2]
When equipping an expansion pouch, there is now a visual that will be displayed for you and other players, hinting at the fact that you're wearing an expansion pouch.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed a bug where the poppets would ignore whether the player is invulnerable or not. This caused that even players with the invulnerable effect were able to be damaged from the poppet manifestation. Another significant bug fix is for the mannequin manifestation not attacking the player when the player would look away multiple times, confusing the game system. This was a bad thing because you even get an achievement for getting attacked by the manifestation! The final bug fix is for another manifestation - the one that can be provoked by incorrectly solving puzzles, or so it was thought that it can be provoked. There was put a system in place that put a cooldown on the provoking, but it turns out it put a cooldown so long that it almost won't get provoked at all!

[h2]About Update 0.3[/h2]
Update 0.3 is on its way. The systems for loading multiple mazes are almost somewhat done. Now comes the bug fixing part of those systems. I'm also currently experimenting with a newer version of Unity - the game engine used to develop this game. If I was be able to port the game to the newest Unity 6, even though it is a preview version, I think the game would greatly benefit from the new features. The only problem is that, well, it is a preview version and preview versions are somewhat not as stable as the normal ones.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new items: Anxiety Pills
[*] Added a visual when a player has one or two expansion pouches equipped.
[*] The poppet manifestation will now appear in various places when it escapes from one of the rooms.
[*] Some optimizations to .save files that make them a little bit smaller.
[*] Fixed a bug where the poppet manifestations would target invulnerable players.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mannequin manifestation would bug out and not attack the player.
[*] Fixed a bug where one of the manifestations was not able to be provoked properly.
[*] Other small fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: The Maze Project Update 0.2
notes.notes:
The long awaited update 0.2 is here! Features brand new stuff, new progression and new dangers to watch out for!

[h2]New Game Progression[/h2]
A new game progression has been added that features new puzzles, secrets and new manifestations. Also, now you can actually finish the first maze!

The new progression also features brand new achievements for the first time. But be aware, these achievements can only be awarded in saves where cheating is disabled.

[h2]New Items[/h2]
There are quite a few new items in this update. Some of them are required for actual progression, while others are only optional that can ease the gameplay. Be prepared for finding and assembling various parts to be able to progress and get to that sweet exit.

The game will also now try to give you hints for what kinds of crafting recipes are out there.

[h2]Interaction Highlighting and Input Hints[/h2]
Ever noticed that white outline that appears when aiming at an item? Well now it appears on every interactable thing there is, not just items, allowing you to be able to spot these things much easier now. 

Along with this, new input hints have been added to the game that appear at the start of a new save. They give you hints as to what various controls do, for example toggling the flashing on by pressing the F key.

[h2]Various Improvements[/h2]
Various improvements and quality of life changes have been made. The most notable one is the saving system, which has been revamped to be more secure and compatible with cloud saving. Unfortunately, older saves that have been saved before 0.2 will become corrupted in the newer version and thus resulting in them not being able to be loaded since the system is not backwards compatible due to security issues.

Another improvements are UI focused, which should make the UI much easier to interact with. For example, now you can close various UIs by pressing your inventory key instead of reaching all the way to the escape key, or if you like it the "mouse style", you can also press the new close button now.

The improvements also reach out to various manifestations. Some of the logic has been changed and improved, meaning that they are now more hostile with perhaps new surprises.

-- Also, watch out for secrets!!!!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added further game progression.
[*] Added new items: Cookie, Enhanced Cookie, Scrap, Large Scrap, Wet Scrap, Bandage Kit, Expansion Pouch, Keycard Part #1, Keycard Part #2, Old Circuit Board.
[*] Added new player effects: Confusion.
[*] Added new achievements: Craftsman - achieved by crafting an item for the first time, Wanderer - achieved by walking 10,000 steps, Back through the void - achieved by dying for the first time, and 9 other hidden achievements.
[*] Added a new manifestation that spawns when provoked by the player.
[*] Added a new manifestation that hides in one of the new rooms.
[*] Added new DoorWalls that will become available once the player has repaired the maze’s mechanism by putting the gears in place.
[*] Added a new Mechanical Spray that sprays various effects on a player that’s in its proximity, activated after the maze’s mechanism is repaired.
[*] Added interaction highlighting.
[*] Added input hints when launching a save for the first time.
[*] Added a new way to reset keybinds.
[*] Added the ability to toggle on/off HUD by pressing F2.
[*] Added the ability to close the crafting menu by pressing the inventory button or with a new dedicated “Close” button.
[*] Added the cheat menu to the keybind options.
[*] Added “Early Access” text below the game’s title in the main menu.
[*] Added a new button for bug testers in the lower left corner of the main menu.
[*] Added more environment details.
[*] Added the ability to open crafting menu even when the player has no items in their inventory.
[*] Rewrote the logic for the first maze exit wall for checking whether all players are in the exit to close the door.
[*] Added a brand new achievement management system.
[*] Modified the Evil Duckie to provoke one of the new manifestations.
[*] Evil Duckie now has a five minute cooldown.
[*] Updated the mannequin manifestation to be a little bit more hostile.
[*] Improved checkpoint saving.
[*] The game now refers to the structures by their respective IDs rather than by their names.
[*] Revamped a part of the game’s saving system.
[*] Changed the json serialization from Unity’s standard one to Json.NET

[*] The maximum amplification for UI sounds has been changed from 0.5x to 0.3x.

notes.title: The Maze Project Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
The Maze Project Update 0.1.5 is here! The focus with this update is mainly on major bug fixes and certain improvements.


[h2]Major Bug Fixes[/h2]
There have been some major bug fixes regarding the multiplayer. The most notable one was that only the host (the person who created the game) was able to see items, while the other players were not able to see them. Also, when hovering over an item that has been dropped by other players, the item preview would sometimes bug out and not work properly for a while. There were also some synchronization problems that caused the Radio Wall to be visible only to the host.


[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[h3]The Maze[/h3]
One of the major issues was that the maze was too big and thus resulting into the players wandering in the maze for long periods of the time without actually finding anything. Aiming to fix this issue, the size of the maze has been reduced by 25%. This may result in spawning in the void where previously there has been a portion of the maze in older saves. When this happens, the game will recognize it and teleport the player back to the starting point.

[h3]Cheat Menu[/h3]
A new "Structures" tab has been added to the cheat menu. This now allows the player to teleport to any particular structure or feature of the maze without having to actually find it.

[h3]Engine Upgrades[/h3]
The Maze Project utilized an older LTS version of the Unity Engine. With this update, the engine is upgraded from the older version 2022.3.2f1 to the most recent LTS version 2022.3.22f1. This should improve the performance a little bit and fix some small bugs.
There is also now HDR support for displays that have the capability to run it.


[h2]Known Issue[/h2]
There is a known issue since the 0.1.4 version that results in some players only seeing the bottom left portion of their screens. Currently, I haven't been able to find a way to reproduce this issue. If this issue affects you, I suggest reverting back to the 0.1.3 version of the game. Right click the game and go to [b]Properties >> Betas[/b] and pick the legacy version 0.1.3.


[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new “Structures” tab to the cheat menu.
[*] Added current and maximum player count in the lobby.
[*] Updated to a newer version of Unity from 2022.3.2f1 to 2022.3.22f1
[*] Added HDR support.
[*] Rewrote the entity spawn system so that it scales with the maze.
[*] Reduced maze size by 25%.
[*] Certain ambience sounds are now clues to when a manifestation spawns.
[*] Added dust VFX for the first maze exit door.
[*] Replaced one ambience sound.
[*] Adjusted the timings of ambience sounds.
[*] The cheat menu will now try to find if there are any available structures or events when being in a different maze or a world, e.g. test map.
[*] Lights are now more frequent in the maze for better visibility.
[*] The game will now automatically save at certain checkpoints in the maze.
[*] Fixed a bug where in multiplayer only the host could see the items.
[*] Fixed a bug where when hovering over an item, the item preview would sometimes bug out in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Radio Wall” was not synced properly in multiplayer and due to that being visible only to the host.
[*] Fixed a bug where the UI background color of an item would briefly change during animation when crafting.
[*] Minor optimizations on the communication between client and server.
[/list]

notes.title: The Maze Project Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
The Maze Project Update 0.1.4 is here! This update includes a new intro, items, and changes to the UI.

[h2]Game Intro[/h2]
In the previous versions, when launching, the game would simply put the player in the main menu without any form of introduction. Now, the game displays an epilepsy warning and then a transition plays that takes the player from the black screen into the main menu.

[h2]New Items[/h2]
Three new items have been added to the game. Rubber Duckie, Evil Duckie, and Vial of Mystery. Rubber Duckie is an item that can alert manifestations when used nearby. Evil Duckie - the more dangerous version of this item - can alert manifestations no matter what the distance is.

The Vial of Mystery is an item that can be either drunk or combined with other items. In this case, the Vial of Mystery can be combined with the Rubber Duckie to craft the Evil Duckie.

[h2]UI Changes and Improvements[/h2]
In the previous update, there was a change to the UI that made it more visible in the dark. However, this change was only for some parts of the UI. This update tries to correct this mistake by making the entire UI more visible.

Changes also affect the save creation screen. Now, when creating a new save, you must check the "Cheats" toggle in order to activate cheats. There is also now a warning that appears when doing this because toggling cheats will deactivate certain features in the future, such as achievements that are planned in a later update.

Another part of the UI Changes and Improvements is the improvements to the game settings. The game settings are now divided into sections for better navigation.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a short intro when starting the game.
[*] Added new items: Rubber Duckie, Evil Duckie, and Vial of Mystery.
[*] Item spawn chances have now been increased.
[*] Added sections to the game settings.
[*] Added an option to hide player nametags.
[*] Added static video noise effect when getting too close to one particular manifestation that lurks around the maze.
[*] Increased detection distance on one particular manifestation that lurks around the maze.
[*] Added a new “Cheats” option when creating a new save. The cheat menu is no longer available in older saves.
[*] The version number is now shown in the bottom right corner of the game’s menu.
[*] The Create New Save screen now automatically appears when the player doesn’t have any saves yet.
[*] Moved the Subtitles option to the Sounds category in the game settings.
[*] The AI navigation graph now gets regenerated when loading an older save just in case some elements were to change.
[*] Some additional improvements to the UI.
[*] The first maze exit door now is able to be open from both sides, fixing an issue where players could get stuck inside.
[*] Fixed a bug with item spawns having bad random positions.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the test map not being able to be saved or loaded.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the camera to clip into the player’s head in the test map.
[/list]
